creator.tagline: Quick home yoga for busy new moms
creator.bio: I am Priya, a certified yoga teacher based in Bangalore. I create 15‑minute home workouts designed especially for new moms who can’t make it to the gym. My videos are simple, safe and fit into a busy day with a baby.

products.title: 15‑min Mom Yoga Checklist
